plugins.name: anti-hung
plugins.description: Keeps chats from hanging: "continue" when the network is back, and compact then continue on prompt-too-long or context-limit stops

plugins.name: pin-note
plugins.description: Pinned notes above the input: the agent keeps sticky notes with numbered points you can answer a few at a time, and they stay put while the chat scrolls

plugins.name: zsh-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Bash tool commands that rely on bash word splitting, which zsh does not do
